generate_difference_report: generate a difference report comparing two benchmark JSON runs with optional color output
calculate_change: calculate the decimal change between an old and new benchmark value
color_format: format a string with or without ANSI color codes based on a boolean flag
find_longest_name: find the length of the longest benchmark name in a list of benchmark JSON objects
review_BenchmarkColor: review the BenchmarkColor class which wraps ANSI escape codes for terminal output formatting
